experiment_name: SelectionGeometry Queries Baseline (v3) vs. Context Menu Matrix Treatment (v4)
hypothesis: Equipping agents with the updated v4 skill (Platform Context Menu Matrix, SystemChannels reference map, and test runner invariants) reduces exploratory grepping cycles across editable_text.dart and toolbars compared to v3, enabling immediate direct implementation and mocking of LookUp, SearchWeb, and Share.
title: [iOS] Add default buttons to SelectionArea context menu

baseline.description: Baseline with flutter-text-domain-expert skill (v3 with SelectionGeometry queries)

treatment.description: Treatment with flutter-text-domain-expert skill (v4 with Context Menu Matrix & SystemChannels Map)

task_prompt_template:
FIRST STEP:
git checkout --quiet {commit}

TASK:
1. Inspect the issue using `gh issue view 141775 --repo flutter/flutter` (do not pass `--comments`).
2. Reproduce and identify the root cause in the Flutter framework.
3. Write a regression test in the appropriate test suite under packages/flutter/test/. Verify the exact failure signature: Did the test fail on the expected expect() assertion or bug-specific exception, or did it fail with an unrelated TestFailure / compilation error? Make sure it fails because of the former.
4. Implement the fix in packages/flutter/lib/src/.
5. Ensure `dart analyze --fatal-infos` and `dart format` pass on all modified files.
6. Verify the regression test passes now that the fix has been implemented.
expected_failure_signature: expect(buttonItems.map((item) => item.type), containsAll([ContextMenuButtonType.lookUp, ContextMenuButtonType.searchWeb])) fails prior to framework fix
